description: This file contains helper functions for managing and filtering Kubernetes node addresses, including adding addresses to a list and filtering addresses based on a provided node IP, used in cloud provider integrations.

methods.name: AddToNodeAddresses
methods.description: Appends new NodeAddress entries to the provided slice if they do not already exist.

methods.name: GetNodeAddressesFromNodeIP
methods.description: Filters and enforces node addresses based on a provided node IP, prioritizing addresses matching the node IP and ensuring only one address per type.
